correctness.rationale: Each normal cone is an integral graphical order cone. Quotient Hasse cover cycles identify singular cones; for K_{2,m} these yield precisely two minimal classes. All comparable-center singular cones specialize to 3-dimensional diamonds, while \(2^m\) full-dimensional incomparable-center cones have no singular proper faces. Unimodular transformations give the conifold and \(2\times m\) Segre determinantal rings. Saturation and orbit-star calculations yield the component geometry. Independent exact finite enumeration for \(m=2,3,4,5\) agrees; it is corroboration, not the proof for all m.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-parameter classification for non-simple complete-bipartite graphic zonotope normal fans. It proves genuine non-purity of the singular locus, identifies exactly and explicitly all positive-dimensional and isolated components and their transverse or full local equations, and determines the non-Q-factorial support. Neither mere graph simplicity tests nor face-vector counts supply this geometric information.
